prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: FOUR-frame body animation sprite sheet for a floating demon god boss, true transparent alpha, square canvas with EXACT 2 columns x 2 rows of EQUAL square cells. Read top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right. Each cell ONE complete character. The image supplied is the ONLY canonical reference: preserve its exact head shape, black-violet muscular body, gold armor edges, red chest core, dark crimson split waistcloth, oblique golden-black halo, two arms and two legs, proportions, pixel palette and fine JRPG pixel-art clusters. Keep the character strictly facing LEFT at the same 60-degree three-quarter angle in ALL frames. Head is an elongated faceted obsidian monolith with NO eyes, mouth, nose, ears, slit, face mark or hair. Preserve the canonical ornate antique-gold outer head frame and TOP/REAR three-pronged architectural crown crest; the front plane stays blank obsidian, no eye-like jewels. Exactly TWO muscular arms with a traceable shoulder-elbow-wrist-hand connection; no extra arms, duplicated fists, disconnected hands, or anatomy formed by VFX. Two bent hanging legs with relaxed pointed feet: this is floating, never walking or planting feet. Clear full-body silhouette in every cell, equal body scale and lighting. Do not let the cloth or halo turn into extra limbs. Full halo must stay behind torso, never clipped. Same non-glowing dark halo except tiny brightness change on cast; no large VFX baked into body, no ground, shadows, scenery, fog, glow backdrop, particles, labels, grid or watermark. Crisp stepped pixel edges and dark outlines, no smooth painting/3D. Coordinates below are normalized per cell from 0 to 1000, fixed origin top-left. Keep every visible pixel inside x=100..900,y=100..900, at least 8% TRANSPARENT space at every cell edge and a clear transparent separator along sheet center. Scale the reference to a full silhouette HEIGHT of about 720 units including halo and feet. Neutral pelvis ROOT (550,555); blank head (430,235); chest core (475,380); near shoulder (455,355), far shoulder (630,360); neutral near fist (345,530), far fist (660,530); near knee (480,695), far knee (595,710); feet (495,845),(605,860). Head/chest/shoulders and lower-body all move together with root offset specified in each frame. Halo and crown upper edge approx y=115. Neutral fists hanging and relaxed knees. Keep body height/proportions constant; motions articulate joints rather than resize the character. No detached energy limbs or extra poses. This sheet is body motion only; existing separate effects will be reused.
Motion: 被弾・撃破
Per-frame trajectory (MANDATORY): FOUR frames but TWO separate motions: top row F1 hit and F2 recovery, bottom row F3 falling defeat and F4 terminal defeated. F1 upper torso recoils RIGHT 25 units and head tilts back10 degrees, near fist raises reflexively (390,450), far fist remains (680,550), feet STILL suspended. F2 return exact hovering reference idle. F3 defeat: body losing levitation, ROOT down125, knees fold toward LEFT, blank head slumps forward, arms fall naturally, halo lowers behind body intact. To fit margin, folding knees reduces total silhouette height without shrinking any body segment. F4 torso collapses/slumps near floor into a seated low folded pose, both legs bent under body, two arms limp down forward, blank head bowed LEFT; halo behind lowers but remains within cell. Same body segment lengths; do not replace with pile of rubble or erase body, no disintegration VFX. Terminal F4 is held and must NOT loop back to F3. Entire crown, halo, knees, hands and feet remain in own cell x=100..900 y=100..900. Keep same scale as other frames.
Keep all four poses as the exact same boss; preserve two muscular arms and ornate blank obsidian head even while slumped. IMPORTANT: four fully separated characters in exact 2x2; defeating is a LOW FOLDED humanoid pose with intact head/crown and connected limbs, not a heap of disjoint limbs or debris. Reference armor and black-gold halo retain same identity. Head and halo must not rotate to right-facing. Background really transparent; no floor or dust.
